notes: Chart conditions: Exposure: 5500 K Daylight, 1/50 sec; Process: ECN-2; Densitometry: Status M.

Fitted: the negative curves (gamma, toeExposure, toeWidth, shoulderExposure, shoulderWidth, per layer) to the neutral scale's dye amounts, computed from the digitized characteristic and spectral dye density charts (sha256 59e3ae0b1cf6b26e60d4269dbdb34e4d8d0f33c41792b29d80303e4708b8fe69, 95255edd0edcb11e8b4acf707c1a773743d2ae3fbe08465acc59cd703c129fb9) through ISO 5-3 Status M; and printingDensity, PD = P·c + b through SMPTE ST 2065-2 APD, fitted on the neutral scale (weighted 10) and a lattice of dye amounts.
Not stored: the fitted per-layer dye-amount offsets and the printing-density offset b (+0.0027, +0.0033, +0.0010); the calibrated printer lights absorb a constant per-layer density.

shoulderExposure lies -0.98, -0.46, -0.91 stops from the last traced sample (at +7.97 stops; negative = inside the traced range). The curve beyond the last traced sample, its flat top, is extrapolated.
Exposures are relative to mid-gray at log10 exposure -1.2995 lux-seconds on the chart, an approximate anchor (see the fit report).

Print gamma rebalanced per channel to 1.3300 / (printingDensity · gamma): a print stock's layer contrasts are matched to the printing-density contrasts of the negatives it prints (SMPTE RP 180-1999 Introduction); without it the gray scale turns green/magenta away from mid-gray. The overall level, the product of print and negative contrast, is carried over from "Emulsion Default" and is artistic (MOV-5).
Hand-tuned, from "Emulsion Default": sensitivity, the print's minimum density, density range, shape and dyes, and the rendering choices.
fitResiduals: measured − fitted Status M density and dye amount per layer over the traced samples, and the printing-density matrix's residuals; they exclude the digitizing error.
